item.title: v0.3.2
item.description:
What's new

  • A new look. A sidebar and redesigned Requests, Log, This Machine, MCP Servers and Permissions pages.
  • Answer requests from the row. Allow once, always allow a server, or deny, also with the keys: ↵, ⌘↵ or Ctrl+↵, ⌫.
  • Automatic updates. On macOS and Windows a new version is installed from the app. Each update is checked against its signature before anything is installed.
  • A Windows installer. Tiny Hive installs with a Start menu shortcut, and an older version can no longer be installed over a newer one.
  • This Machine shows updates. The Updates line says which build you have, whether a newer one is out, or why updates cannot be checked.
  • Licences per account. When the licence of one Control Plane runs out, only that account stops; your other accounts keep running.

Fixed

  • "The hive-link core did not start" after the computer was switched off suddenly.
  • Long folder names now fit on one line, "Any" filters in the Log clear the filter, a server you switch on shows Running once it is up, and an answered request closes.
